description: Attenuator and attenuverter for two signals, one knob setting the level of both, with a straight and a sign-flipped output for each

params.text: Sets the level applied to both channels; in attenuate mode the travel runs from silence to full level, and in attenuvert mode from full inversion through silence to full level
Picks attenuate, where the LEVEL knob runs from silence to full level, or attenuvert, where it runs from full inversion through silence to full level

inputs.text: One of the two signals passed through the LEVEL knob; polyphonic, with every channel scaled by the same amount

outputs.text: Carries that channel's input scaled by the LEVEL knob
Carries that channel's input scaled by the LEVEL knob and then flipped in sign

notes: the lamp shows the LEVEL knob setting rather than the signal level: green while attenuating, red while inverting, and brightest at full level or full inversion
